propositions: test_rendered_output_is_byte_identical_to_the_landed_renderer intermittently kills its pytest-xdist worker on macOS py3.13 due to exceeding the per-test 300s timeout
the test processes 884 renderable units with ~1768 serial pandoc spawns in a single monolithic loop, taking 91.6s idle and 504.8s under CPU saturation (1.7x past 300s guard)
pytest-timeout's thread method calls os._exit(1) from a timer thread, causing the worker to die without a traceback rather than failing the test
the fix chunks the equivalence test into fixed-size batches of 40 units parametrized by pytest.mark.parametrize, reducing per-test cost from 504.8s to 38.05s under saturation
a coverage guard test asserts all chunks reassemble to exactly _renderable_units() with >= 100 total units, preventing silent unit drops during future corpus modifications
